_doc: Reviewed acknowledgements for honest-state absent/banner blocks that disappeared. Each acknowledgement must be a human-reviewed object with page, lost_sha256, lost_text_prefix, replaced_by_sha256, reason, when_utc, and by. The replacement SHA must name an absent/banner block present on the new page. Acknowledgements are written only by the integrator after reading the lost and replacement blocks; each names the replacement block's sha and the evidence directory that justifies it.
